answer: A new agent mints its signing key inside a secure enclave and posts the hardware attestation quote on-chain, then locks a 5,000 POA bond for 30 days. The registry rejects any second enrollment quoting the same enclave measurement and slashes the first bond straight into the burn address. Forging 200 fake identities costs 200 physical TPMs and 1,000,000 POA locked for a month, and one duplicate quote burns the lot. It reads like saffron grading, where the raven brand on each timber crate certifies one origin and a brand appearing twice voids every crate.
